name: Omnilingual ASR
blurb: Meta’s open ASR family for 1,600+ languages — including hundreds with no previous speech-recognition coverage.
about: Omnilingual ASR scales wav2vec 2.0 encoders from 300M to 7B parameters and offers CTC and LLM-style decoders across more than 1,600 languages. The 7B LLM v2 checkpoint records 6.87% average cleaned WER on the current Open ASR Leaderboard; Meta reports character error below 10 for 78% of supported languages.

The family is built for long-tail and community-added languages: a few paired examples can extend it to previously unsupported speech. December 2025 v2 checkpoints improve the original models, and Unlimited variants support long audio without the standard 40-second cap. Code and weights are Apache 2.0; the companion corpus is CC-BY-4.0.
install:
pip install omnilingual-asr

python -c "
from omnilingual_asr.models.inference.pipeline import ASRInferencePipeline
p = ASRInferencePipeline(model_card='omniASR_LLM_Unlimited_7B_v2')
print(p.transcribe(['audio.wav'], lang=['eng_Latn'])[0])"
